- Daily Caller Editorial: FAIL (-0.6, -0.7) — Weaponizes real overreach for partisan cultural framing.

Geoff Ingersoll critiques automated surveillance expansion by highlighting the absurdity of prosecuting a suburban mother over a playground swing incident.

The Bright Side:
Exposing petty bureaucratic overreach helps push back against heavy-handed municipal surveillance creep.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing a specific municipal overreach case (WHO/WHAT) with a systemic indictment of all security tech.

It is a structural bait-and-switch: using a genuine injustice to fuel blanket anti-institutional panic.

Social Physics Analysis:
By leveraging an isolated absurdity to stoke generalized resentment, the commentary trades constructive reform for cultural friction, projecting systemic malice onto local bureaucratic clumsiness.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Amplifying legitimate grievances with inflammatory framing drives societal division.

The Unavoidable Truth: Automated surveillance systems frequently produce absurd overreach against innocent citizens.

The Unavoidable Lie: Every local enforcement error is part of a coordinated authoritarian conspiracy.
